title: The Old Light F2 - The Late Laugh
_note: Old Light floor 2 (pearlmoor_oldlight_2). The same theme, same oom-pah and tempo as F1, but the jokes land LATE: every "ha-ha-ha" starts a beat late and spills over the barline into the next phrase (the bar-24 laugh wraps round the loop seam into bar 1), the "pfft" arrives a beat after that, and the rimshot crash lands on the next downbeat. A lagging triangle echo repeats each ANSWERING phrase (bars 5-7, 13-15, 21-23) one beat behind the lead, like an audience a beat slow on the uptake. 126 BPM, 4/4, F major, 24 bars.
